propositions: The snapshot-GC worker lock was not included in doctor's lock census despite using the same stamped-lock mechanism as drain and compact-worker locks

A detached snapshot-GC worker process that dies between acquiring and releasing its lock leaves a stamped lock file invisible to doctor_locks.scan_locks because the census only probes tracker-adjacent locks
Adding the snapshot-gc-worker leg to the census requires deriving the per-host snapshot-store root path without creating directories, to maintain the diagnostic's read-only guarantee
The snapshot-gc-worker leg uses the same v2 ownership stamp and staleness adjudication table as other stamped legs, so doctor's existing _existence_report reader is sufficient
A missing snapshot store is reported as a free lock with no holder, matching the behavior of absent compact-worker and drain lock files
